by_region = df.groupby('region')['revenue'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
print(by_region.round(2))
top, runner_up = by_region.index[0], by_region.index[1]
gap = by_region.iloc[0] - by_region.iloc[1]
print('gap', round(gap, 2))
print('gap_pct', round(100 * gap / by_region.iloc[1], 1))
result = {'top': top, 'top_revenue': round(float(by_region.iloc[0]), 2), 'runner_up': runner_up, 'gap': round(float(gap), 2)}
